fixed: DIREKTE NÅ live-item channel label wrapping mid-word (375/393px): 'NRK' split into 'N'/'RK' and 'NR'/'K', '45'' clock split into '45'/'''
notes: Root cause: .live-item .live-meta had 'flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere' — flexbox could shrink the right-hand meta column narrower than a single word, so even a 3-letter channel like NRK broke character-by-character.

Fix (docs/css/cards.css): 'flex: 0 0 auto' (stop shrinking below content) and dropped 'min-width: 0'; kept 'max-width: 42%' and changed overflow-wrap to 'break-word'. The title column now absorbs the squeeze; the meta wraps only at the 42% cap, at word boundaries.

Verified in a controlled fixture reproducing live.js's liveEventRow DOM at 375/393px dark: before showed 'N'/'RK' + '45'/''', after shows 'NRK' and '45'' intact while the long 'YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club) +1' label still wraps at spaces within its column (original intent preserved).
